description: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two systems, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across different categories of task complexity. The horizontal axis displays the categories, ordered from left to right as Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis represents the value and is labeled "Execution Accuracy," utilizing a linear scale with a visible range from 20 to 60 and tick marks at regular intervals of 10 units. The chart features grouped vertical bars, where each category contains two adjacent bars representing the different systems. According to the legend positioned at the top, the light blue bars represent NatSQL and the dark blue bars represent TA-SQL. Every bar is visually emphasized with an annotation of its exact numerical value placed directly above it. Across the chart, the lowest execution accuracy is recorded by the light blue NatSQL bar in the Challenging category at 32.32, while the highest accuracy is achieved by the dark blue TA-SQL bar in the Simple category at 63.14. In the Moderate category, NatSQL scores 39.64 and TA-SQL scores 48.60, and in the Total category, NatSQL reaches 51.35 compared to TA-SQL's 56.19. The bars are not sorted by height but are arranged by the implied difficulty of the categories followed by the overall total.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two systems, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across three task complexity levels: Simple, Moderate, and Challenging, as well as a Total category. The horizontal axis categorizes the task complexity, labeled as Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis represents execution accuracy, ranging from 20 to 60 in 10-unit intervals. TA-SQL consistently outperforms NatSQL across all categories, with the largest margin observed in the Moderate category, where TA-SQL achieves approximately 52.60 compared to NatSQL's 39.64. In the Challenging category, TA-SQL shows a slight decline to 34.11, while NatSQL remains stable at 32.32. Overall, TA-SQL demonstrates a steady increase in accuracy across complexity levels, culminating in a total accuracy of 58.19, which is significantly higher than NatSQL's 51.35.
